nodes.label: Implementation Map and Verification Record
nodes.rationale: Tracks phase-by-phase implementation against 21_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN with gate evidence; numbered specs are canonical, the combined file is a convenience copy.

nodes.label: Working Instruction 2026-09-07 (implement remaining modules before tests)
nodes.rationale: User asked to complete the platform before deciding where tests run; new work is recorded as implemented/awaiting verification, never as a passed financial gate.

nodes.label: Phase Status Table (0-2 passed, 3 in progress)
Arabic Operational Desk Visual Design
nodes.rationale: Cool paper/ink/petrol palette, IBM Plex Sans Arabic + Noto Sans Arabic, tabular numerals, compact tables and right-hand rail; no oversized KPI cards.

nodes.label: No Seeded Real Financial Data or Tax Rates
Append-Only Audit and Immutable Ledger MySQL Triggers
nodes.rationale: Database-level triggers enforce immutability of audit logs and posted journals/lines; production migrations need a separate account with trigger privileges.

nodes.label: Task 1.1 - Store and Accounting Master Configuration
Configurable Account Mappings
nodes.rationale: Mappings configurable before use; remapping used accounts requires a controlled financial migration rather than silently moving balances.

nodes.label: Task 1.2 - Exact Journal Posting and Reversal
Reversal as Linked Unique Entry (original stays posted)
nodes.rationale: Originals keep status posted; reversal is derived from a linked unique reversal entry instead of updating the original.

nodes.label: Task 2.2 - Movement Ledger and Serialized Stock
MariaDB to MySQL 8.4 Runtime Migration (erp_store_mysql8)
nodes.rationale: Local environment had drifted to MariaDB; user authorized MySQL 8 adoption preserving data: 320 rows/41 tables hash-verified, 83 FKs checked, original DB untouched.

nodes.label: Adjustment Approval on Gross Absolute Movement Value
nodes.rationale: Compares gross missing+additional serial value even when net is zero; threshold zero reviews all; opening always requires approval; payload/policy version rechecked.

nodes.label: PO Approval Threshold Policy (base-currency total incl. tax)
Document Counter Locking-Read Fix (updateOrInsert race)
nodes.rationale: MySQL repeatable-read snapshots and Laravel updateOrInsert's non-locking existence check allowed duplicate keys; allocator now updates/inserts from locked row state.

nodes.label: Task 3.3 - Goods Receipt and PO Quantity Matching
GRNI (Goods Received Not Invoiced) Clearing
nodes.rationale: Receipt posts Dr Inventory / Cr GRNI at frozen receipt-date FX; supplier invoice later clears GRNI so receipt values never change on invoicing.

nodes.label: Isolated MySQL 8.4 Test Instance (port 3308)
nodes.rationale: Sustained E: disk I/O pressure slowed tests; disposable test data moved to a separate instance while the active store on 3307 was left untouched.

nodes.label: Task 3.4 - Supplier Invoice Matching, AP, Input VAT and Private Attachments
Purchasing Invoice Policy (price variance / non-recoverable tax blocked by default)
nodes.rationale: Configurable ambiguity: variance and non-recoverable tax blocked unless an explicit versioned policy maps them to expense; no statutory VAT percentage assumed.
